title: Create and wire in one task
note: Deliberately at the edge of the '<=3 files, one observable outcome' rule the planner is told to respect. If the green rate collapses here but holds on 01-03, the answer is smaller tasks, not a bigger model.
prompt: Add a status footer. Create src/components/StatusBar.vue that takes a prop `message` (string, required) and renders it inside a <footer> with class 'status'. Then use it in src/views/HomeView.vue below the existing HelloWorld, passing the message 'Ready'. Import it with the @/components alias the way HomeView already imports HelloWorld.
guard_note: Assertions flagged `guard` are regression checks — they hold on the untouched seed and exist to catch a model that rewrites the file and drops existing content. They are scored separately from task assertions.
